name: Sesto Fiorentino (Italy)
description: White field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Sesto Fiorentino (a pair of compasses on red and blue) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Sesto Fiorentino, a comune in Tuscany; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Sesto Fiorentino arms — pair of compasses on red and blue, crowned, within branches
